reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Stage a simulated marketing-advisor panel that compares named frameworks, preserves disagreement, and ends with a choice-ready recommendation.
neutralIntentExamples: compare positioning advice from several explicitly selected marketing lenses
surface trade-offs among competing launch recommendations before choosing a direction
operations: load available context; select relevant simulated advisors; write separate framework-grounded takes; mark disagreement; synthesize trade-offs without claiming the real people participated
failureBehavior: ask for the missing question or context; label unsupported attribution; stop short of a consensus when the lenses genuinely conflict
usefulInvariants: each take is tied to a stated lens
materialRisks: persona authority can make heuristic advice look like expert endorsement
weak source grounding can turn stylistic imitation into fabricated attribution

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Produce a fast SEO snapshot by making three parallel DataForSEO metric requests after credential preflight.
neutralIntentExamples: get a quick domain snapshot of rankings traffic and backlinks
decide whether a full SEO audit is justified from three core metric groups
operations: run credential preflight; halt for setup or auth outcomes; request domain overview backlinks and ranked keywords in parallel; present returned metrics with their provider scope
failureBehavior: stop when credentials are absent or rejected; never echo credentials; distinguish a setup wizard from a completed snapshot
exclusions: writing credentials to an unapproved location
usefulInvariants: the three metric calls remain distinct
missing data is reported rather than filled in
materialRisks: third-party metrics can be stale or estimated
parallel failures can be mistaken for an all-clear snapshot

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Design a referral or affiliate system around customer value, acquisition economics, mechanics, incentives, and measurable activation loops.
neutralIntentExamples: choose a referral incentive ceiling from LTV and existing CAC
outline an affiliate program with attribution rules and fraud checks
operations: separate customer referral from partner promotion; map trigger and reward mechanics; set eligibility and attribution; model unit economics; define launch tests and optimization measures
failureBehavior: request missing economics or audience details; flag an incentive that exceeds plausible value; preserve fraud and compliance questions as open work
usefulInvariants: reward economics are checked against LTV and CAC
referrer and referred-user outcomes are distinguished
materialRisks: poor fraud controls create direct spend leakage
incentives can attract low-quality or self-referred accounts

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Plan social content, repurposing, short-form video, scheduling, and listening triage against a stated audience and business objective.
neutralIntentExamples: turn one long-form asset into platform-specific posts and a short video
triage brand mentions and choose which conversations merit a response
operations: choose platform formats; define pillars and hooks; adapt one idea to channel constraints; build a calendar; classify listening signals; draft responses or escalation notes
failureBehavior: ask for goal audience or platform constraints; mark unavailable source material; escalate sensitive mentions instead of improvising a public reply
usefulInvariants: each asset has a platform and objective
repurposing changes format rather than blindly duplicating copy
materialRisks: cross-posting can violate platform norms
public replies can create reputational or privacy harm

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Prototype a centered single-column product-launch HTML email with a wordmark, hero treatment, headline, specifications, and one primary CTA.
neutralIntentExamples: turn a launch brief into a 600 to 680 pixel email structure
check that a product email keeps one idea and one conversion action
operations: read the active design system; select display and color tokens; arrange masthead hero headline body specs and CTA; retain table-friendly centered layout
failureBehavior: request missing product or brand inputs; avoid placeholder claims when the brief lacks a real benefit; flag unsupported rendering behavior
materialRisks: email clients may strip styles or alter layout
invented product details can become customer-facing misinformation

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Diagnose signup friction by classifying flow type, mapping required data and steps, and connecting drop-off evidence to focused conversion changes.
neutralIntentExamples: find the highest-friction step in a free-trial registration flow
decide which signup fields can be removed without losing activation context
operations: separate trial freemium paid waitlist and B2B flows; inspect steps and field necessity; locate drop-off; weigh friction against activation and compliance; propose tests
failureBehavior: ask for missing funnel evidence; avoid claiming an optimization without baseline data; retain compliance requirements as non-negotiable
usefulInvariants: every field has a stated purpose or is questioned
drop-off claims cite a measured step
materialRisks: lower friction can reduce qualification or activation
collecting unnecessary identity data raises privacy exposure

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Assess local-search map presence through tiered geo-grid, profile, review, NAP, competitor-radius, and LocalBusiness-schema checks.
neutralIntentExamples: compare a local business map visibility grid across a target keyword and location
find conflicting business name address and phone records across map platforms
operations: select the lowest viable data tier; keep website SEO separate; run map presence or grid checks; compare reviews and NAP; map nearby competitors; construct schema data
failureBehavior: declare unavailable API tiers; distinguish platform observations from website checks; qualify rank results by location and sampling
usefulInvariants: map and website surfaces remain distinct
business identity is verified before NAP changes
materialRisks: location sampling can overstate visibility
third-party listing changes can create duplicates or wrong identities

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Rewrite machine-like marketing copy into a recognizable human voice while preserving audience, goal, facts, and brand constraints.
neutralIntentExamples: make a robotic landing-page draft sound direct and specific for its audience
remove clichéd AI phrasing while retaining the original offer and proof
inputs: brand voice notes or context file
operations: read voice context; identify canned phrasing and flat rhythm; rebuild openings examples opinions and stakes; preserve verifiable claims; compare before and after against the goal
failureBehavior: request a voice example when no context exists; flag unclear claims; avoid polishing content whose intended audience or purpose is unknown
usefulInvariants: meaning and factual claims are preserved
human tone does not mean invented evidence
materialRisks: over-editing can erase a brand's actual voice
casual language can introduce unsupported certainty

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Route Ahrefs-backed requests for domain metrics, backlinks, organic keywords, or content exploration while recording provider scope and comparison rules.
neutralIntentExamples: retrieve referring-domain and backlink evidence for a specified URL
compare Ahrefs organic metrics with another approved source and explain discrepancies
operations: verify the tested MCP dependency; select metrics backlinks organic or content route; attach source and confidence to every metric; reconcile disagreements in favor of the defined provider rule
failureBehavior: stop when the extension is unavailable or token is missing; report installation prerequisite; never imply live data when the call did not run
materialRisks: provider drift can break the tested integration
metric definitions may differ across tools

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Evaluate a free marketing tool by tying a useful calculation or generator to audience value, acquisition, SEO, promotion, and maintenance economics.
neutralIntentExamples: decide whether an ROI calculator can attract qualified leads without becoming a vanity asset
scope a free grader with a useful result and a credible follow-up path
operations: test problem reality; choose tool outcome; define inputs and result; assess lead capture and SEO fit; set quality safeguards; estimate build and upkeep; plan distribution
failureBehavior: reject a tool with no genuine user value or owner; mark unknown demand instead of assuming traffic; expose maintenance cost
exclusions: collecting leads without a clear value exchange
building the tool in this review
usefulInvariants: the free result stands on its own
lead capture does not precede value without justification
maintenance is part of the decision
materialRisks: low-quality calculators damage trust
interactive inputs may collect sensitive business data

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Score content quality through who-how-why evidence, E-E-A-T signals, readability, thinness, and readiness for AI citation.
neutralIntentExamples: audit a page for first-hand experience and trustworthy authorship signals
identify thin sections that need evidence or consolidation before publication
operations: apply the who how why test; inspect experience expertise authority and trust cues; identify unsupported or thin passages; assess readability and citation clarity; prioritize repair
failureBehavior: qualify scores when author or source context is absent; separate observable text defects from algorithm speculation
usefulInvariants: thinness is judged by user value not word count alone
materialRisks: heuristic scores can look more precise than evidence permits
citation optimization can reward formulaic prose

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Route founder questions through a virtual executive bench spanning finance, marketing, product, operations, people, legal, data, security, AI, communications, engineering, and staff work.
neutralIntentExamples: decide which C-suite perspective is needed for a cross-functional launch risk
run a structured multi-role review before choosing a founder-level priority
operations: classify the issue; select relevant cs roles; gather role-specific questions; compare advice; synthesize a decision and unresolved dependencies
failureBehavior: ask for scope when a question spans too many roles; mark role assumptions; keep legal or security uncertainty unresolved pending qualified review
usefulInvariants: fictional advice is not presented as human approval
materialRisks: executive framing can overstate confidence
sensitive company details may be copied into a broad simulated panel

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Plan paid advertising across major platforms by aligning objective, audience, creative, offer, budget, and optimization evidence.
neutralIntentExamples: choose a paid-media test structure for a defined acquisition goal and budget
compare retargeting and prospecting decisions while keeping measurement explicit
operations: classify campaign objective; define audience and funnel stage; map creative and copy; set budget and bidding hypotheses; specify conversion tracking; plan optimization loop
failureBehavior: ask for goal budget and conversion event; qualify benchmarks; do not recommend activation when tracking or consent state is unknown
usefulInvariants: every test names its success metric
spend and privacy boundaries are explicit
materialRisks: budget can be consumed before signal stabilizes
targeting data can create privacy or discrimination risk

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Prototype a paywall or upgrade path by exposing value, reducing decision friction, and testing plan choice without obscuring access conditions.
neutralIntentExamples: diagnose why a paywall view is not converting eligible users
design an upgrade comparison that makes limits and next value legible
operations: map the trigger; clarify value and limits; compare plan choices; align CTA with readiness; identify experiment variants; preserve entitlement and billing dependencies
failureBehavior: ask for plan rules and funnel data; flag unclear entitlement behavior; avoid dark patterns when urgency or cancellation terms are absent

materialRisks: aggressive friction can damage trust and retention

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Construct lifecycle email sequences from a trigger, audience relationship, conversion goal, timing, and exit condition.
neutralIntentExamples: outline a welcome sequence whose messages progress from orientation to activation
choose delays and exits for a re-engagement flow without mailing converted users
operations: classify sequence type; define progression; assign one job per email; set delays and conditional exits; map segmentation; draft measurement events
failureBehavior: request trigger or goal when absent; flag impossible timing or missing exit event; keep unverified personalization out of drafts
materialRisks: bad segmentation can annoy or expose recipients
missing suppression rules can send after conversion

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Create or maintain the canonical marketing context used by sibling skills for positioning, audience, voice, and foundational product facts.
neutralIntentExamples: draft a first marketing context from an existing product repository
update the ICP and voice sections without losing established positioning decisions
operations: inspect available README pages copy and docs; choose auto-draft interview or update mode; place canonical context at the defined path; surface corrections and gaps
failureBehavior: mark unknown facts; ask for correction after a draft; preserve existing canonical context before updating
usefulInvariants: owner review remains part of the workflow
materialRisks: stale context propagates wrong assumptions across many skills

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Cluster keywords by shared SERP results and turn the groups into hub-and-spoke content architecture with internal links and optional briefs.
neutralIntentExamples: group a seed topic by actual top-result overlap rather than wording similarity
design a pillar and spoke map with an internal-link matrix
operations: expand seed variants; fetch or inspect top results; group by overlap; name hub and spokes; map links; optionally produce briefs or route execution
failureBehavior: separate text similarity from SERP evidence; report sparse results; stop execution when the content tool is unavailable
exclusions: keyword grouping based only on lexical similarity
usefulInvariants: hub and spoke roles are explicit
materialRisks: search results change over time
large expansions can incur provider cost or create thin content

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Plan and track software-directory submissions as a staged discovery and backlink program tied to fit, positioning, and lead quality.
neutralIntentExamples: prioritize Product Hunt, G2, and niche directories for a launch sequence
build a submission tracker that distinguishes backlink value from qualified discovery
operations: rank directories by audience fit and credibility; prepare listing variants; record status and required assets; separate backlink from discovery outcomes; schedule follow-up
failureBehavior: flag unknown directory rules; avoid claiming dofollow status without verification; hold submissions lacking approved product facts
materialRisks: low-quality directories can harm reputation
duplicate or incorrect listings fragment identity

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Find and rank local SEO prospects by searching a niche and city, excluding aggregators, enriching domains with three parallel data views, and scoring closeability.
neutralIntentExamples: build a shortlist of local businesses with weak SEO and plausible sales fit
compare prospect closeability after domain, on-page, and backlink enrichment
operations: run credential preflight; search the local query; remove named aggregators; enrich remaining domains in parallel; combine evidence into a 0 to 100 closeability score

materialRisks: scores can encode noisy or stale SEO metrics

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Capture and compare SEO baselines across titles, metadata, headings, schema, social tags, performance, and status signals to detect drift.
neutralIntentExamples: establish a known-good SEO snapshot before a deployment

operations: fetch and parse the page; record critical SEO fields; save a baseline; compare later observations; classify additions removals and changes; retain history
failureBehavior: report fetch or parse failure; distinguish unavailable performance data from unchanged data; do not overwrite a baseline silently
exclusions: treating a changed field as automatically harmful
usefulInvariants: current and baseline sources are distinguishable
materialRisks: dynamic pages create noisy diffs

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Route a marketing request to content, SEO, CRO, channel, or analytics work and coordinate a multi-skill campaign sequence.
neutralIntentExamples: choose the right specialist path for a mixed SEO and conversion request
sequence research, content, landing-page, and measurement work for a campaign
operations: load context; classify request; select one or more specialist routes; order dependencies; identify handoffs; audit cross-functional gaps and metrics
failureBehavior: ask for missing goal or context; avoid routing by vague keyword alone; surface unavailable specialist dependencies
usefulInvariants: handoffs retain assumptions and open questions
materialRisks: router errors can send work to the wrong discipline

operations: distinguish finding literature from planning research; select one of four branches; keep heavy intake in the branch; summarize returned findings and boundaries
